images.view: High aerial view from a distance, with the whole shipyard visible inside the frame.
images.subject: A spaceship construction dock, one vast open-air dry dock cut deep into the rock and open to the sky, with gantry cranes along its rim.
images.detail: A sleek newly finished starship with a wide, flat, angular hull and swept wings hovers level above the dock floor, its long axis along the dock, lifting out on bright engine glow.
images.state: Far-future high-tech industry in active use, with seamless composite panels, polished metal and illuminated light strips, all kept spotlessly clean, and clear air over a clean paved dock floor.
images.site: The dock is cut into a plateau of dark neutral grey rock blanketed in deep white snow and snowdrifts, with its rock walls streaked with ice, on a frozen lifeless alien planet of bare rock, ice and wind-blown snow.
